title: Do Not Update Until This Is Fixed
text:
I paid for the full version of this app because it worked exactly as advertised. At the time, it simply used a calculator style password to protect my private photos and videos. After updating, the app completely changed its security system by introducing iCloud and other sign in options. Once the update was installed, everything I had stored was gone.

Whether this was caused by the update or a migration issue, the result was the same, I lost access to all of my important files. There was no clear warning that updating could affect existing data, and I feel like I wasted my money paying for the premium version.

I cannot recommend paying for this app if your photos and videos are important to you. Until the developers fix this issue and provide a reliable way to recover files after updating, I would strongly advise backing up your data or avoiding the app altogether.
